pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.d4 cxd4
pages.notes: Overview vague; plans had ...b5 with the b5-bishop still there and an unlikely ...d5 break. Rewrote the overview around 5.Qxd4 and ...a6 (bishop pair); plans 1, 3, 4 rewritten.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nc3 cxd4 6.Qxd4
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...b5 with White's bishop on b5. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nc3 cxd4 6.Qxd4 e5
pages.notes: Plan 3 named knight routes from b8 and f8 that do not exist; plan 4 called the c1-bishop light-squared; plan 1 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote all four plans (reviewer caught that the d7-knight is pinned, so ...Nc5 now follows ...O-O); British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Moscow Variation, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 credited Black with the bishop pair after the light-squared bishops are traded, and had ...a6-b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Moscow Variation, Sokolsky Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White fianchetto with Bg2 after the light-squared bishop was traded. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 around the d4/Nxd4 Maroczy bind and the ...g6 setup; British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: 3.Bb5+ Bd7 4.Bxd7+ Qxd7 5.O-O Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 said c3-d4 challenges the d7-queen; plan 3 named squares the parser read as moves; the overview credited Black with light-square prospects. Rewrote the overview and all four plans (plan 2 rewritten after the reviewer could not confirm ...e5).

pages.name: Sicilian: 3.Bb5+, Sokolsky, 5...Nc6 6.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White play g3 and Bg2 without a light-squared bishop; the overview called the line Rossolimo deferred. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: Sicilian: 3.Bb5+, Sokolsky, 5...Nc6 6.Nc3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed a light-squared bishop White no longer has (Be2); plan 3 sent the queen to b7, occupied by a pawn; the overview gave Black a bishop pair. Rewrote the overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Bd7 4.Bxd7+ Nxd7 5.O-O Ngf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 named impossible knight routes; plan 2 credited Black with the bishop pair. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian, Chekhover, 4...a6 5.c4
pages.notes: Plan 3 named the occupied d4 as a target square for manoeuvring; rewrote it around ...Nc6 with tempo on the queen and ...g6/...Bg7. British spelling in the overview and plan 4.
